Context: Core case of the Silicon Cowboys film wrap-up. Founded 1982. Fastest company to Fortune 500 and $1B annual sales by 1987; by 1995 surpassed IBM as the world largest PC supplier.
Financing_Deal: Seed at $0.003 (founders); $2.5M Series A; $5.0M Series B; $25M Series C. NO bank loans - the deck explicitly corrects the film.
Investors_Acquirer: Sevin Rosen (all three rounds); IVP (B and C); acquired by Hewlett-Packard 2002
Valuation: IPO market cap ~$500M (~$1.7B in today dollars) on $111M revenue = ~5x revenue
Lesson: A home run at IPO followed by a wild 20-year public ride. Estimated founder ownership was only 5-7% each at IPO - dilution across three institutional rounds is severe even in a famous success.
